desc: Buck Mark Vision models feature more than striking looks, they are also deceptively lightweight. The solid steel barrel is replaced with a smaller diameter inner steel barrel that is surrounded by a tensioning outer aluminum sleeve. With a Buck Mark Vision, you get legendary accuracy in a much lighter, more nimble package that is ideal for field and competition use. The Buck Mark Freedom Vision is a great firearm to celebrate the 250th anniversary of the birth of the United States. From the "250 Years of Freedom" machining in the barrel sleeve, to the red, white, and blue color palette, this is a handgun you'll be proud to own and pass down. The Browning Buck Mark has withstood the test of time and remains a favorite among rimfire plinkers and competitive shooters. The single-action, blowback operated autoloading design is one of simplicity and reliability. The controls are easy to reach and use
